sloka: सर्व ऋतु सुख सेव्यानि फलन्ति अन्ये नगोत्तमाः ।महा अर्हाणि मणि चित्राणि फलन्ति अन्ये नगोत्तमाः ॥४-४३-४६॥
transliteration: sarva ṛtu sukha sevyāni phalanti anye nagottamāḥ ।mahā arhāṇi maṇi citrāṇi phalanti anye nagottamāḥ ॥4-43-46॥

translations.english: 'There the trees are filled with flowers and fruits in all seasons. Birds rest on them. By their excellent fragrance, taste and smooth feel the fruits and flowers satisfy the desires of all. Some other excellent trees provide barks of various kinds which are used for cloth.
translations.hindi: इन वृक्षा में सदा फल फला करते हैं, और उन पर पक्षी भरे रहते हैं । उनकी गन्ध, उनका रख और उनका स्पर्श दिव्य है ओर वे सब मनोरथो को पूर्ण करने वाले हैं
